parameters.content:
## B - Build Schedule

Daily at 07:47 Europe/Belgrade (after the 6-hourly sync), or on demand.

Only items on an **enabled** board are considered. A listing already in
the queue is reported, never queued twice. A listing posted less than
`REPOST_AFTER_DAYS` ago waits.

Slots come from `SLOTS` in config (now 10:00/15:00/20:00). Boards
rotate by `priority` so the same board never posts back to back.

Captions are built from the pin text (`TEXT_MODE=pinterest`). Pinterest
puts the same block in title AND description, so they are
de-duplicated, then trimmed to `POST_TEXT_MAX_CHARS` on a sentence
boundary, with the Etsy link last.

### Why the "gate" nodes exist

An n8n data-table `get` executes **once per input item**. Chaining three
reads directly would make the second return the table once per row of
the first, and the third once per row of the second.

Each gate collapses its branch to a single item. The rows stay
reachable by name: `$('Load Items').all()`.

nodes.name: Daily At 07:47
nodes.notes: Off the hour on purpose: :00 is the busiest minute on any scheduler.

nodes.name: Boards Loaded
nodes.notes: Single-item gate - keeps the next table read from running N times.

nodes.name: Items Loaded
nodes.notes: Single-item gate - keeps the next table read from running N times.

nodes.name: Plan Schedule
nodes.notes: All the queueing rules. Unit-tested in src/scheduler.test.js and src/post-text.test.js (52 cases).

nodes.name: New Queue Row?
nodes.notes: TRUE = a listing with no schedule row yet -> insert.

nodes.name: Repost Or Report?
nodes.notes: TRUE = a listing past its repost cooldown -> UPDATE its existing row. schedule.etsy_listing_id is unique, so a repost must reuse the row rather than add a second one.

nodes.name: Insert Queue Row
nodes.notes: No alwaysOutputData: zero planned posts must mean zero rows.

nodes.name: Update Queue Row
nodes.notes: Resets a served-cooldown row back to queued and clears the old Facebook id, error and posted_at.

nodes.name: Write Build Log
nodes.notes: The full report, including the explicit "already scheduled" list.
